verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents file-size, duration, or concurrency limits. The only related items are customizable security policies (Open, Limited, Secure, Websafe) and a claim about handling giga-pixel datasets, and neither states what the limits are. Security-policy tailoring is an adjacent control, not documented limits a developer could size jobs against, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, file-size, duration, and concurrency limits are documented, so I can size jobs before hitting a wall
